description: This Java class, MockLegacyKeypadCluster, simulates a legacy keypad device in a mock Zigbee environment, allowing testing of input events (e.g., button presses) and LED control functionalities, and implements battery-powered device behavior.

classes.name: MockLegacyKeypadCluster
classes.description: A mock representation of a legacy keypad device used for testing and simulating keypad actions in a Zigbee network.

classes.name: KeypadButton
classes.description: Enumeration representing different buttons on the keypad that can be simulated.

classes.name: LEDColor
classes.description: Enumeration representing different LED colors available on the device.

classes.name: LEDMode
classes.description: Enumeration representing different LED modes (off, solid, blinking) for the device's indicator.

classes.name: ServerMfgCommand
classes.description: Constants for server-initiated manufacturer commands specific to this device.

classes.name: ClientMfgCommand
classes.description: Constants for client-initiated manufacturer commands specific to this device.

methods.name: requestPanelStateChange
methods.description: Simulates a keypad button press to request a change in the panel's state (e.g., arm/disarm).

methods.name: parseSetLEDEvent
methods.description: Parses payload data to set LED mode and color, with logging and error handling.

methods.name: handleMfgCommand
methods.description: Handles manufacturer-specific commands, such as setting LED states, and delegates others to superclass.
